caption:
Total Loss from @suncorp closed their first Battle of the Tech Bands set with The Rolling Stones' "Paint It Black", sax and all. They had been playing together for 12 years before they got to The Triffid, and their 16-year-old drummer is the youngest performer in BotTB history. The judges gave them the top song-choice score of the night.

Video shot by @quirkylikethat and @kurtboldy, live audio by Nick Forrester.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. All proceeds to @youngcareoz, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
